dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Did you bring enough supplies? Don't forget to re-hydrate and replenish your energy while we have some down time!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: We're lucky to have this place — it's much safer and better equipped than a makeshift camp in the wild. But still, you shouldn't get complacent and forget to take care of yourself. You'll only end up regretting it later...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? How would I know? Uh, I mean, because... well... *sigh* Do I really have to answer that?
